sources.authority: Primary street identity: two occupied floors, cedar upper storey over a full brick ground storey, two street-facing end gables framing the broad transverse connector, three prominent wide upper connector window groups with narrower/partly tree-obscured end transitions, corresponding lower groups and central glazed entrance with timber porch. Left roofed bicycle shelter, low planting, seating and clear public approach. Use actual visible grouping/occlusion boundaries; do not turn every partly hidden pane into a new equal-width bay.

Rear-courtyard relationship authority: two parallel two-storey wings extending behind the front connector; both rear wing tips are gabled, the rear mouth remains open to play lawn. Courtyard-facing classroom glazing on both levels, roofed low timber walks along both wing interiors and connector rear, outdoor tables/benches/planting. It is a rear elevated view of different elevations, not an alternative front facade. Visible classroom occupation informs programme category only.

Corroborates only a U footprint with two longitudinal parallel wing ridges and one perpendicular transverse front-connector ridge, seated corner roof junctions, open uncovered rear court and no rear closing bar. Elevated oblique projection, not the requested <=10-degree near-nadir. Excluded from facade counts, entrance/canopy shape, metric lengths, slope, relative ridge/eave heights and precise valley coordinates.

roof_graph.body: Two occupied storeys in a U: front connector and two parallel side wings; rear courtyard mouth stays open to play lawn.
roof_graph.main_ridges: Two parallel longitudinal wing ridges and one transverse front connector ridge. Connector terminates into wing roof fields; do not assume equal heights.
roof_graph.junctions: Solve actual intersecting/clipped roof planes, valleys and complete lining/carrier closure. Projected source crossings are not metric intersection coordinates.
roof_graph.secondary_roofs: Low covered timber walks along courtyard edges and modest front porch/bicycle shelter. These are secondary roofs, not fourth main volumes.
roof_graph.excluded: No rear closing bar, roof over court, tall gym, tower, dormers or extra storeys.

facade_material_observation: Images coherently show full brick ground storey with vertical cedar above; this governs construction rather than the original low-brick-base wording.
source_limits: Front governs three prominent connector upper window groups plus narrow or obscured transitions; tree occlusion does not create an additional repeated bay.
Top changes connector front groups to four and alters canopy/site details; exclude those features.
Top is elevated oblique, not near-nadir; use topology only, no metric width/depth/height/slope/proportions.
Hidden outer wing elevations and complete programme, room partitions, stairs, fixtures, support contacts and landscape extents require explicit inference.
remaining_inferences: 52 by40m envelope, wing/connector widths and site allocation.
Eave/ridge levels, actual roof intersections/lining/fascias and canopy support contacts.
Occupied room count and programme, connected stairs and floor voids, furnishings and every route.
Source-conditioned cedar/brick physical scale and bounded mapping; glulam/glass/fixtures remain unapproved until relevant review.

independent_source_review.scope: Source compatibility and authority assignment only. Direct full-resolution inspection of three source images, exact generation prompts/input hashes and progress brief. No constructor, model, material specimen, physical contact, walking, keeper or catalogue approval.

next_step: Measured plan/roof/camera/programme draft, source-conditioned materials and independent prebuild review before dedicated U-school constructor.
